scenes.about: A deleted element (a tombstone of a higher version) is gone.
scenes.name: rules-deleted-element

scenes.about: A write older than the deletion that arrives later does not bring the element back.

scenes.about: A later write of a higher version replaces the element; an older version arriving after it is ignored.
scenes.name: rules-higher-version-wins

scenes.about: Two writes of one version: the one with the lower nonce wins, whatever order they arrive in.
scenes.name: rules-same-version-lower-nonce-wins

scenes.about: The board is cleared, then drawn on again; a clear drops writes that were pending in the same step.

scenes.about: A snapshot part-way through the log merges into the board (it does not replace it); one older than what is there changes nothing.

scenes.name: rules-stacking-order-by-z-then-id

scenes.about: Elements the board refuses: an unknown colour, a size of 0, a stroke with a stray coordinate, empty text, a sheet that is too small, a half-named deck page. Only the good ones are drawn.
scenes.name: rules-invalid-elements-are-dropped

scenes.about: A size over 200 is drawn as 200.
scenes.name: rules-size-capped-at-200

scenes.about: Records of the lesson's quiz game are in the log and the board ignores them.
scenes.name: rules-quiz-records-are-skipped

scenes.about: One renderer and replay draw 60 s, then 10 s, then 40 s, then 5 s and 60.5 s: each frame must equal one drawn from a fresh replay (here, the web player's).

scenes.about: A stroke someone is drawing, growing as updates add points; then their finished element replaces the preview.
scenes.name: presence-stroke-growing-then-finished

scenes.about: Updates that do not follow on: points from the middle of a stroke continue what is shown, a new stroke number starts again.

scenes.about: Previews of a rectangle, an ellipse (drawn backwards), an arrow and some text, each by a different person.
scenes.name: presence-shape-and-text-previews

scenes.about: A person's elements record clears their own preview only: the rectangle's owner is done, the stroke's owner is still drawing, and the teacher's write clears neither.

scenes.about: A preview is shown for 6 s after the person's last update, then dropped: the stroke at 7.9 s and gone at 8.1 s; the rectangle (sent at 6 s) outlives it.

scenes.about: Pointers and the names that come with them are not part of the video: only the line preview is drawn.

scenes.about: A preview that is a sheet, the view or a malformed stroke draws nothing.
scenes.name: presence-sheet-view-and-malformed-previews-are-ignored

scenes.about: A preview that edits an element by reference. The board patches only graphs, solids and symbols (pack elements; the maths scenes cover the drawn ones): for a rectangle or an unknown id nothing is drawn and the element stays where it is.

scenes.about: A preview that would make the element invalid (an empty view, an unknown shape, a corner that is not a number): nothing is drawn for it and the element stays as it is.
scenes.name: maths-preview-that-does-not-decode-is-ignored

scenes.about: A graph whose formulas are rewritten while someone types: the new curve and point replace the old ones, the grid goes.
scenes.name: maths-preview-series-replaced

scenes.about: A preview that is replaced by a cursor alone: the graph is drawn as it was.
scenes.name: maths-preview-ends-and-the-element-returns
